name: wwjd
description: What Would Johannes Do: opinionated UI/UX rules and workflow. Three skills (wwjd:ux for structure, behaviour and copy; wwjd:look for the look; wwjd:motion for motion), a cold critic agent, a prompt hook that routes UI work, a lint hook after UI edits, a gate (new-project start question, Strictness checks), the /wwjd sidebar and an optional project board.

hookmode.title: Hooks: on, quiet or off
hookmode.description: on: routes UI prompts, lints edits and gates new UI files and handovers (default). quiet: routes and lints, never blocks. off: no wwjd hooks. A project's .wwjd.json "hooks" wins.

boardmode.title: Project board: on or off
boardmode.description: on: a new project offers a shareable board, and each handover adds its round (default). off: Claude never creates or updates one. A project's .wwjd.json "boardMode" wins.

creativity.title: Look: plain ↔ expressive
creativity.description: 1 Plain … 3 Balanced (default) … 5 Expressive. /wwjd → Settings shows every stop.

budget.title: Content: lean ↔ rich
budget.description: 1 Minimal … 3 Balanced (default) … 5 Rich. /wwjd → Settings shows every stop.

density.title: Spacing: roomy ↔ compact
density.description: 1 Roomy … 3 By product (default) … 5 Compact. /wwjd → Settings shows every stop.

motion.title: Motion: still ↔ lively
motion.description: 1 Still … 3 By product (default) … 5 Lively. /wwjd → Settings shows every stop.

voice.title: Copy: terse ↔ warm
voice.description: 1 Terse … 3 Plain (default) … 5 Warm. /wwjd → Settings shows every stop.

strictness.title: Strictness: fast ↔ strict
strictness.description: 1 Fast … 3 Standard (default) … 5 Strict. /wwjd → Settings shows every stop.
